newsitem.title: UK: UK stock market takes dive on tax credit move.
newsitem.headline: UK stock market takes dive on tax credit move.

text.p: The British stock market took a sharp dive on Tuesday after the Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said shareholders would no longer be able to claim tax credits on share buybacks or special dividend payouts.

The surprise statement wiped almost 30 points off the FTSE 100 share index, which had held steady around 4,024 points prior to the news, weakened slightly by a lower close on Wall Street overnight and lacklustre debt markets.
By 0758 GMT, the FTSE 100 was down 34.3 points at 3,997.2, just two points off its low as shares linked most closely to buybacks and special dividend payments led the rout.
